decision: Selected the centroid (computed in UTM 17N) of Franklin County tax parcel 510-180711 (225 Rathmell Rd / S High St, owner Magellan Enterprises LLC, tax mailing name Google LLC, class 375 data center) as the campus locator of the Google Columbus data-centre campus; the CLB4 building is not separately located.
layer: Franklin County, Ohio Auditor tax parcel service (gis.franklincountyohio.gov hosting ParcelFeatures/Parcel_Features FeatureServer layer 0, "Tax Parcel"; native CRS EPSG:3735)
method: Polygon(s) returned with outSR=4326; centroid of the (union) polygon computed in UTM zone 17N (EPSG:32617) with pyproj 3.7.1 and shapely 2.1.1 and transformed back to WGS84; geodesic areas on the WGS84 ellipsoid.

native_crs_cross_check.note: Native EPSG:3735 (US survey feet) ring centroid transformed locally with pyproj 3.7.1; the 0.93 m offset is the same NAD83-to-WGS84 offset seen for other Franklin County parcels.

facts.permit_layer_points_note: All four distinct City of Columbus permit-layer points for the parcel fall inside it; the CLB4 alteration and the CLB4 A new-structure permits carry different points (the latter shared with CLB3), so the permit points are not treated as building locations.
